notes: UNO: draw and discard piles stay visible during dealing and between turns; playable cards lift on your turn; action sound effects; Catch UNO applies two cards when an opponent catches an uncalled UNO first. Wordle: typing/delete/submit sounds, wrong-word buzz/shake, purple repeat-letter badges, bigger keyboard/board, higher keyboard and rounded tiles. Poker New Game opens a fresh table; hosted NPCs rotate through the eligible roster without duplicate or main-character opponents. Updated Zendaya, Paris Hilton, Lady Gaga and Terry Crews portraits with clear transparent margins. Nicki Minaj retains her existing portrait because the replacement request was rejected by the image service. New avatar-framed rankings with medal tiers, saved local rankings, performance-percentage awards with half stars, accuracy/mistake/hint and measured-time grading and Android backup mirror, plus merge-safe copy/restore backups. Rounded menus and result panels use Qurio colors without adding levels, shops or item currencies. Solitaire uses unbiased cryptographic shuffling, verified across 10,000 unique-deck deals and stock reshuffles. Streaming services and their dependencies are removed; bundled music, sound settings and song switching remain. Live server ranking sync is deliberately deferred to the next update; all local results remain saved for future sync. Stars use performance percentage and half-star steps, with puzzle time/mistake/hint breakdowns. Existing active rooms, scores and saves are preserved.
